patterns.title: Core coroner recommendations recur across reporting cycles
patterns.neutral_summary: The 2022 death-review panel explicitly said the 2017 panel recommendations remained relevant and required; the 2023 urgent panel then revisited the 2022 safer-supply recommendation.

patterns.title: Standards, oversight, and evaluation remain recurring requests
patterns.neutral_summary: Coroner, public-health, audit, and federal expert sources repeatedly call for accountable systems, standards, monitoring, and evaluation, although the exact scope differs by source.
patterns.owner_review_reason: The sources use overlapping but non-identical concepts of regulation, standards, oversight, and evaluation.

patterns.title: Access expansion recurs across treatment modalities and age groups
patterns.neutral_summary: OAT, youth treatment, adult system-of-care, treatment-capacity, and First Nations-led chains all contain commitments to reduce access barriers or bring care closer to home.

patterns.title: The B.C. government recurs as issuer, funder, responder, and implementer
patterns.neutral_summary: Normalized actor mapping finds the B.C. government or its health ministries in 15 of 21 chains, with distinct roles that should not be collapsed into a single responsibility label.

patterns.title: Regional health authorities are recurring delivery organizations
patterns.neutral_summary: Health authorities recur as recommendation recipients or service implementers in seven chains and provide the most concrete location-level operational evidence.

patterns.title: Aggregate commitments often omit resource-level identity
patterns.neutral_summary: Bed totals and funding announcements can demonstrate policy activity while still omitting the facility name, operator, access route, or canonical identity required for a Miller resource link.
patterns.owner_review_reason: Some aggregate announcements may overlap across fiscal years or program inventories.

patterns.title: Rural, remote, and northern access recurs as an implementation concern
patterns.neutral_summary: Multiple chains identify travel, prescriber access, or local treatment capacity outside major urban centres and include targeted virtual, mobile, or Nation-led responses.
patterns.owner_review_reason: The evidence demonstrates targeted responses but does not establish population-adjusted adequacy.

patterns.title: Several system-level reforms remain partial across multi-year evidence windows
patterns.neutral_summary: The system-of-care, prescribed-alternatives, coroner, and treatment-capacity chains contain implementation activity alongside later evidence of remaining scope or reporting gaps.
patterns.owner_review_reason: Partial status describes documented scope, not an effectiveness or compliance judgment.

patterns.title: The decriminalization exemption was amended twice within sixteen months
patterns.neutral_summary: The federal exemption took effect in January 2023, was amended for youth-oriented areas after 230 days, and was amended again for public spaces 232 days later.
patterns.owner_review_reason: Temporal amendment history is factual; reasons and effects remain politically contested and are not inferred.

patterns.title: Professional standards provide comparatively strong version traceability
patterns.neutral_summary: OAT prescribing, pharmacy, nursing, and controlled-delivery materials commonly expose effective dates and update or supersession relationships more clearly than funding announcements do.

patterns.title: Aggregate implementation totals are difficult to reconcile to individual services
patterns.neutral_summary: Provincial totals for beds, sites, and calls are useful implementation evidence, but the public record does not always provide a stable inventory that reconciles each total to named services.
patterns.owner_review_reason: Different sources may report distinct service classes, dates, or fiscal cohorts.

patterns.title: First Nations-led delivery requires separate governance and funding roles
patterns.neutral_summary: The Indigenous-services and treatment-capacity chains show provincial funding relationships, FNHA support, and local First Nations governance; the service operator must not be described as a provincial program merely because provincial funds are involved.

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: The Assisted Living Regulation took effect in 2019; supportive-recovery standards followed in 2021.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The later panel repeated the need for regulation, oversight, evidence-based quality, monitoring, and evaluation.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: substantially similar recommendation repeated after partial rule implementation
repeated_recommendations.owner_review_reason: The regulation and standards demonstrate action but do not by themselves prove complete oversight or outcome monitoring.

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: OAT expansion actions were documented, but the 2022 panel said the earlier access recommendation remained relevant and required.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The later panel placed OAT within a broader evidence-based continuum of care.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: continued access concern documented alongside implementation activity

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: Distributed drug-checking implementation was reported in 2021.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The later report retained drug checking as part of the still-relevant earlier recommendations.
repeated_recommendations.owner_review_reason: Repetition may reflect desired scale or access rather than absence of implementation.

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: A prescribed safer-supply program and measured enrolment were documented.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The 2023 panel focused on non-prescribed alternatives, which is materially broader than the earlier prescribed model.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: later report revisited the same toxic-supply concern with a changed implementation path
repeated_recommendations.owner_review_reason: The recommendations are related but should not be treated as identical.

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: The Adult Substance Use System of Care Framework was published in December 2022.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The later urgent report focused on toxic-supply access while documenting continued mortality and referring back to the 2022 panel.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: later report revisited the broader crisis; exact recommendation repetition is uncertain
repeated_recommendations.owner_review_reason: This is a recurrence signal, not a literal repeat of the continuum recommendation.

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: No exemption was yet in force; the federal exemption was approved in 2022 and took effect in 2023.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The federal task force recommended ending criminal penalties nationally, while the earlier PHO report proposed B.C.-focused mechanisms.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: substantially similar policy direction repeated by a different authoritative body

repeated_recommendations.implementation_between: The federal government acknowledged the task-force work and later renewed its drug strategy; no single national service-standard instrument was located.
repeated_recommendations.material_change: The renewed strategy contains coordination and service-system activity but does not cleanly reproduce the proposed national standards.
repeated_recommendations.review_signal: later strategy revisited system coordination; implementation of the specific standards remains unclear
repeated_recommendations.owner_review_reason: The original concept may not map to one later instrument.
